policy: Uncommitted regular tracked nonbinary nonmedia current file: hide above 1 MiB when above 5 MiB or plain changed-line count is unavailable or exceeds 500.
changed_lines: Actual git diff --numstat without whitespace filtering, with literal old and current pathspecs; no hunks/counts/status/path/membership rewrite beyond clearing hidden hunks.
model: Optional snake_case hide_reason=file_too_large, omitted from legacy/default DTOs and changes-list summaries.
renderer: UNCHANGED; read-only pending actual #1100 merge and owner handoff. Backend candidate alone cannot make the mounted placeholder assertions pass.
frozen_fixtures: source.json and all three frozen cases/assertion files unchanged
residuals: All/historical/turn scopes, missing or small current files with large old content remain outside this bounded repair.
Untracked/media/symlink behavior is excluded, not new size-policy coverage.
Git still obtains/parses the full patch before the policy; no early acquisition or native performance claim.
